Name: Justowenya's Semi Realistic Portraits
Author: Justowenya
Description:
[center][font=Times New Roman][u][i](This is my first portrait mod.)[/i][/u]

[/font][size=3]Are you tired of only seeing anime portraits on your Stardew Valley nexus mod feed? are all the portraits seem to never get your vision of that one character right? well stranger, you're just like me. Lucky for us i made this portrait mod that COULD be what you imagine or maybe you just liked the art style because you wanted something a lil bit more realistic than a cute anime portrait.[/size]

[size=3]This is my first mod so if you have any trouble with it or have any suggestions on what character i should add next please let me know, i'll try to finish this mod as soon as possible jsjsj[/size]

[u][b][i][font=Verdana][size=5]NOTE:[/size][/font][/i][/b][/u]
[size=4]I recommend to click "track" to see future updates, either for new characters or for already made characters that i might edit and make better :) [/size]
[/center][b][i][u][font=Comic Sans MS]INSTRUCTIONS FOR MOD NEWBIES (in comic sans):[/font][/u][/i][/b]

[size=3][i][font=Comic Sans MS]1) Download the mod and find your stardew valley mods folder (in my case it's in steam/ steamapps/ common/ stardew valley)
2) Decompress the mod.
3) Start Smapi (INSTALL IT!!) and if my stupid mod worked than it should be all done.[/font][/i]
[/size]
Three simple steps.
